text: Groq LLC announced a $350 million Series A on August 17, 2026, led by Disruptive with planned participation from NVIDIA, valuing the company at $3.5 billion; Groq's Executive Chairman, Alex Davis, is CEO of Disruptive.
short: Disruptive led Groq's $350 million Series A in 2026.

source.name: Groq: Groq Closes $350 million Series A, Building the World's Leading AI Inference Cloud
source.quote: Groq LLC ("Groq") today announced a $350 million Series A fundraise and the round was led by Disruptive, with planned participation from NVIDIA.
